title: feat-070-chat-ticket-promotion-contract Conformance (Errata + Deterministic Tests)
conformance_objective: Close drift: spec line 114 incorrectly states 'HTTP 200' for absent requested_mode in IT_OP, but Surface Matrix shows llm_chat (Network) is DENIED. Correct behavior is HTTP 202 (fallback to ticket). Also make SDT scenarios verifiable with deterministic tests (no E_PATH_TRAVERSAL bypass).

implementation.note: Implementation is test-only. No changes to production code. Setup deterministic AGENTICOS_DATA_DIR via t.TempDir() and remove E_PATH_TRAVERSAL bypass patterns.

conformance_fixes.issue: SDT states 'THEN HTTP 200' for absent requested_mode in IT_OP
conformance_fixes.contradicts: Surface Matrix: IT_OP deniega llm_chat (Network), permits ticket_create (Write)
conformance_fixes.fix: Correct expectation: HTTP 202 (fallback to ticket) when llm_chat denied but ticket_create allowed
conformance_fixes.note: This is an errata in feat-070 spec, not a change to runtime behavior. Runtime behavior is correct per feat-070 design.

conformance_fixes.issue: Tests 'pass' by accepting E_PATH_TRAVERSAL as a valid outcome
conformance_fixes.contradicts: E_PATH_TRAVERSAL is a test environment error, not a contract outcome
conformance_fixes.fix: Configure AGENTICOS_DATA_DIR=t.TempDir() so CreateTicket() works. Remove bypass patterns.

conformance_fixes.issue: No test for backpressure rejecting returns 429 + Retry-After

out_of_scope: Changes to mode.go or security semantics
Changes to error contract runtime (beyond making SDT verifiable)
